answer: A sybil tax blocks bulk fake identities. Each identity pays a non-refundable fee of 50 credits to register, and the fee is burned, never refunded. Making 1,000 fakes costs 50,000 credits, while one honest agent pays only 50. Even at the nadir of demand, it leaves no oasis of free identities. Like a comet burning on entry, a fake spends its fee and vanishes profitless, while the honest agent earns back its 50 credits from undiluted rewards.
